verdict.rationale: Vercel is a platform, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. It documents an official remote MCP server at mcp.vercel.com, with OAuth, the Streamable HTTP spec, one-command setup, per-client setup guides, and a broad documented tool inventory covering projects, deployments, logs, analytics and domains. Access is limited to an allowlist of approved clients, which is a minor restriction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works in practice, and support for arbitrary unapproved MCP clients.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Vercel's official MCP server. It's a remote MCP with OAuth that gives AI tools secure access to your Vercel projects available at: https://mcp.vercel.com
Connect your AI tools to Vercel using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that lets AI assistants interact with your Vercel projects.
Vercel MCP tools let your AI assistant work with your projects, deployments, logs, and other Vercel resources.
connect the official Vercel MCP server once for use across projects.
